data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Thomas, meaning 'twin' or 'companion'. In the New Testament, Thomas is one of the twelve apostles, known as 'Doubting Thomas' for his disbelief in the resurrection. Thomasina, as a feminine form, symbolizes a loyal and steadfast companion or friend. The name Thomasina carries the meaning “Twin, Companion” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Thomasina usually hope their child will grow to embody twin, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Θωμασίνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Θωμασίνα είναι ένα ελληνικό ονοματεπώνυμο που προέρχεται από το όνομα Θωμάς. Ο Θωμάς είναι ένας από τους δώδεκα αποστόλους του Ιησού και το όνομά του είναι συνώνυμο με την πίστη και την πνευματικότητα. in_latin.name: Thomasina
in_latin.long_meaning: Thomasina, nomen femininum, est origine Hebraica, a Thoma, qui significat 'fidelis', 'piissimus', et 'perfectus'. In contextu Christiano, Thomasina est nomen sancti Thomae Apostoli, qui fuit unus ex duodecim apostolis Iesu Christi. Nomen huiusmodi significat fidem, perseverantiam, et perfectam fidem.
